messages.subject: mutivariate model with correlated parameters and outcomes
parts:
Hi

I am running into some issues with a model. Here is the deal, i have a working univariate model, where the parameters (b) are correlated. Now i am working in a multivariate model, where i want to have all the parameters correlated (from all the independent variables), and i also want to have correlated all the dependent variables.

I think the issue is that the parameters are an array of vectors(vector[parmt] b[nsubj,nvars]; ), and i think it doesnt works easily with the multi_normal function.

From the following code i get the next error:

I am attaching the code, and a simulated data example.

I appreciate any help to make this work

Thanks

mod_lkj_mv_1ch <- "
data{
int n;
int parmt;
int nsubj;
int nvars;   
int pt_nv; 
vector[nvars] y[n]; // arrray of order y[n,nvars]
int id[n];
real x[n];
vector[pt_nv] pm;
cov_matrix[pt_nv] cov_vb;
cov_matrix[nvars] cov_vm;
vector[nvars] mm;
}

parameters {
vector[parmt] b[nsubj,nvars];
vector[parmt] mub[nvars];
corr_matrix[pt_nv] Sigma_corr_b;
corr_matrix[nvars] Sigma_corr_y;
vector<lower=0>[pt_nv] Sigma_sd_b;
vector<lower=0>[nvars] Sigma_sd_y;
}

transformed parameters {
cov_matrix[pt_nv] Sigma_b; // covariance matrix
cov_matrix[nvars] Sigma_y; // covariance matrix

for (m in 1:pt_nv) {
Sigma_b[m,m] <- Sigma_sd_b[m] * Sigma_sd_b[m] * Sigma_corr_b[m,m];
for (k in (m+1):pt_nv) {
Sigma_b[m,k] <- Sigma_sd_b[m] * Sigma_sd_b[k] * Sigma_corr_b[m,k];
Sigma_b[k,m] <- Sigma_b[m,k];
}
}

for (m in 1:nvars) {
Sigma_y[m,m] <- Sigma_sd_y[m] * Sigma_sd_y[m] * Sigma_corr_y[m,m];
for (k in (m+1):nvars) {
Sigma_y[m,k] <- Sigma_sd_y[m] * Sigma_sd_y[k] * Sigma_corr_y[m,k];
Sigma_y[k,m] <- Sigma_y[m,k];
}
}
}

model{

Sigma_corr_b ~ lkj_corr(2.0);

Sigma_corr_y ~ lkj_corr(2.0);

for (j in 1:nsubj){
b[j] ~ multi_normal(mub, Sigma_b);
}

{
vector[nvars] mu[n];
for (i in 1:n){
for (k in 1:nvars){
mu[i,k] <- b[id[i],k,1] + b[id[i],k,2] * x[i];
if (x[i] > b[id[i],k,4])
mu[i,k] <- mu[i,k] + (b[id[i],k,3] * (x[i] - b[id[i],k,4]));

y[i] ~ multi_normal(mu[k], Sigma_y);

mu[k] ~ multi_normal(mm, cov_vm);
}
}
}

for (k in 1:nvars){
mub[k] ~ multi_normal(pm, cov_vb);
}

}"
